MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Create, inspire, and bring heart to every plate 

Down here on the sun-dappled shoreline, something special is taking root. 

Opening in July 2026, Heirloom is a coastal kitchen and dining space nestled within a stunning new retirement living community just south of Sydney. With sweeping waterfront views, a Mediterranean soul, and a deep love for shared stories and slow meals, Heirloom is where old traditions meet new memories-open to the public, but grounded in the lives of our residents, their families, and friends. 

We're looking for Casual Chefs (full-time & part-time) to join our founding team-someone who cooks with care, consistency, and creativity, and who thrives on making every dining experience memorable. 

Your opportunity 

Must be available Thursday to Sunday

Based at our new Heirloom Restaurant at Taren Point, you will take ownership of daily kitchen operations, preparing and presenting high-quality Mediterranean-inspired meals for residents, guests, and the local community. You will lead by example, ensuring food safety, quality, and service excellence while mentoring and supporting the caf team. 

With professionalism, passion, and a love for hospitality, you will: 

Prepare and deliver high-quality, seasonal dishes inspired by Mediterranean flavours 

Plan menus, manage stock ordering, and oversee kitchen operations 

Ensure compliance with HACCP, WHS, food safety, and hygiene regulations 

Lead and support kitchen staff, providing training and guidance where needed 

Monitor costs, assist with budgets, and suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency 

Engage warmly with residents, guests, and team members, contributing to a welcoming and vibrant environment 

What you'll bring 

Commercial Cookery Certificate or equivalent 

Minimum four years' experience in a chef or cook role, preferably in caf or restaurant settings 

Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards 

Excellent communication, literacy, and teamwork skills 

A collaborative, positive approach to supporting and mentoring others 

Creativity and passion for delivering consistent, high-quality food experiences 

Desirable but not essential: 

Experience in aged care or retirement living environments 

Knowledge of Mediterranean cuisine or other fresh, seasonal cooking styles 

Why join us? 

Be part of something from the ground up-shaping the culture and energy of a brand-new venue 

Work in a beautiful waterfront setting 

Make meaningful connections with a regular, close-knit community 

Bring your personality, ideas, and culinary creativity to a team that values care, innovation, and a sense of humour 

Enjoy Monday-Friday work, flexible options, salary packaging benefits, and ongoing professional development 

Because at Heirloom, it's not just about cooking-it's about creating moments that make people feel at home. 

Apply Now! 

If this sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to hear your story. To apply for this role, please click the 'Apply' button. 

Anglicare Sydney is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities, and cultural backgrounds. 

Disclaimer: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 
Application Close Date: July 30, 2026    Click here to Apply now →

  Job type:  Contractor, flexible

  About the company:   

 Our client is a leading neurodivergent-affirming centre dedicated to providing customised support across the lifespan, from diagnosis through to strength-based therapies and family support services. Specialising in Autism, ADHD, Anxiety, Sensory Challenges, Emotional Regulation, and Mental Health support, they are committed to helping individuals thrive by focusing on strengths rather than deficits. 

 The centre fosters a warm, supportive, and community-focused environment where every client and family is valued, and every clinician is encouraged to contribute as part of a collaborative multidisciplinary team. 

   

  About the role:  

 An exciting opportunity is available for a Psychologist to join our client's growing team on a contractor basis. 

 Working with children, adolescents, and adults, you will provide evidence-based psychological support tailored to individual needs and goals. You will have the opportunity to work alongside Occupational Therapists, Speech Pathologists, Music Therapists, Art Therapists, and Support Specialists to deliver holistic, client-centred care. Services may include: 

 
	 Individual therapeutic interventions 
	 Psychological assessments and observations 
	 Emotional and behavioural regulation support 
	 School anxiety support 
	 Resilience building and confidence development 
	 Independence and life skills development 
	 Learning support 
	 Sensory and emotional wellbeing support 
	 Ongoing NDIS-funded supports 
 

   

  Benefits:  

 
	 Attractive revenue split arrangement 
	 Dedicated consulting room provided 
	 Full administrative and reception support 
	 Established referral pathways and client demand 
	 Work within a highly collaborative multidisciplinary team 
	 Flexible contractor arrangement with autonomy over your schedule 
	 Neurodivergent-affirming workplace culture 
	 Opportunity to work with children, adolescents, adults, and families 
	 Supportive leadership team that genuinely values clinicians 
	 Modern, welcoming clinic environment 
	 Opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a thriving community-focused service 
 

   

  Requirements:  

 
	 General Registration with the Psychology Board of Australia (AHPRA) 
	 Eligibility to provide psychological services under Medicare and/or NDIS (highly regarded) 
	 Experience working with neurodivergent individuals, including Autism and ADHD, is highly desirable 
	 Strong commitment to neurodivergent-affirming and strengths-based practice 
	 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
	 Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team

Position Description Inherent Requirements

We will review applications as we receive them.

About Epworth Richmond

Epworth Richmond is a rapidly growing, fast-paced and dynamic teaching hospital where you will work alongside highly skilled practitioners in all areas. You will challenge your skills, broaden your experience, and grow your expertise through exposure to a wide range of clinical specialties, treatment options and the latest in technology. Epworth will support you to provide the best possible care to our patients by continually investing in your education, better facilities, and technologies.

At Epworth, it's a community. It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation that puts the patient in the centre of all that is done. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Epworth's enhanced Not for Profit status (and not available in the public sector) provides the opportunity for employees to salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

At Epworth, we care.

We care about our patients and we care about our people. We care about keeping everyone safe. We care about valuing and empowering our people, and growing careers. And we care about giving our people support and flexibility to thrive, and contribute to our communities.

Enquire - Apply 

Sound interesting? To apply, click the I'm Interested button and attach your CV and cover letter.

For more information, refer to the attached position description or contact Medical Recruitment on medicalrecruitment@epworth.org.au.

It is a condition of employment with Epworth HealthCare, subject to reasonable exemptions, that you have had an annual Influenza vaccination, where this is required under Epworth policy.
